target.description: The target values being filtered for.

wrappingExp.description:
The expression to apply to target. If not specified, it is treated as {@link Genai.Query.Operator.Expressions#any}.

See Genai.Query.Operator.Expressions

linkingOperator.description:
The operator to link this filter to the preceding filter in {@link Genai.Query#filters}. For example,

```
<fileType, [{ wrappingExp: 'any', target: ['pdf'] }, { wrappingExp: 'any', target: ['doc'], linkingOperator: 'AND' }]>
```

is interpreted as

`(intersects(fileExt, ['pdf'])) && (intersects(fileExt, ['doc']))`

openingParens.description:
The number of opening parentheses to add before the filter expression. More than one parenthesis could be needed
when filters that already have their own parentheses are combined with an `AND` operator, such as in
{@link Genai.Query#addFilters}. On a given {@link Genai.Query.SourceFilter}, this value might differ from
#closingParens, but in an array of filters on {@link Genai.Query#filters}, the sum of all #openingParens must
equal the sum of all #closingParens. For example, the filters:

```
{
  tags: [
    { target: ['tag1', 'tag2'], wrappingExp: 'any', openingParen: 1 },
    { target: ['tag3'], linkingOperator: 'AND', openingParen: 1 },
    { target: ['tag4'], linkingOperator: 'OR', closingParen: 2 },
    { target: ['tag5'], openingParen: 1, closingParen: 1, linkingOperator: 'AND' }
  ]
}
```
results in C3 Filter:

```
(intersects(tags, ['tag1', 'tag2']) && (intersects(tags, ['tag3']) || intersects(tags, ['tag4']))) && (intersects(tags, ['tag5']))
```

closingParens.description: The number of closing parentheses to add after the filter expression. See #openingParens for more details.

title:
Type representing a single filter object for a query. Each array of filters in {@link Genai.Query#filters} is linked
using #linkingOperator, #openingParens, and #closingParens to create a single filter expression.
name: Genai.Query.SourceFilter
